name: IMAP Mail
description: Reads mail over IMAP with an app password, and attaches to the mail base as a provider

accounts.description: One entry per account, keyed by the account's local id. Written by the account setup form; the password lives in the plugin secret store, never here.

address.description: The email address, which is also the IMAP username

imap_port.description: IMAP port (993 for TLS, 143 for STARTTLS)

imap_tls.description: TLS from the first byte, or an upgrade after connecting

smtp_host.description: Outgoing server hostname. Absent means this account can read but not send

smtp_port.description: Outgoing port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS)

smtp_tls.description: How the outgoing connection is encrypted

display_name.description: What the console shows for this account

roles.description: Mailbox path to role, for a server whose folder names Walnut cannot guess

append_sent.description: Put a copy of every sent message in the Sent folder over IMAP. SMTP tells the mailbox nothing, so without this the Sent folder stays empty

server_saves_sent.description: The outgoing server files its own Sent copy, so Walnut must not add a second one. Gmail does this; most other servers do not

accounts.label: IMAP accounts
accounts.help: Add an account from the Mail app rather than by hand: the setup form proves the credential before storing it

append_sent.label: Save sent mail to the Sent folder
append_sent.help: Turn this off only if your provider already files its own copy

server_saves_sent.label: My outgoing server saves sent mail itself
server_saves_sent.help: Turn this on for Gmail: it already saves anything sent through its own SMTP, so Walnut adding a copy would give you two
